heroSummary: Forsyth County Schools begins the 2026–27 school year on Thursday, August 6, 2026, and ends on Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break runs September 28–October 2, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, and Spring Break is April 5–9. Holiday Break ends January 1, but students return on Tuesday, January 5, after a professional development day on January 4.
calendarNotes: The official Forsyth County Schools 2026–27 student calendar lists 178 student days: 85 in the first semester and 93 in the second semester. K–12 early-release days are September 4, December 18, and May 27. Online learning and parent conference dates are October 16 and March 12. The district lists October 19, January 4, February 16, and March 15 as professional development days when students do not attend school.

sourceReviewDetails: We check this page against the district's published first day, last day, major breaks, holidays, online learning and parent conference dates, early-release dates, and professional development days shown in the official source.

If we find a mismatch, we correct the page and update the review date. Campus-specific bell schedules, testing dates, staff details, and program events may appear only in the official PDF or individual school calendars.
The downloadable calendar file is a one-time import generated from the calendar records used for this page, and the official district calendar remains the source of record for last-minute changes.

calendarFaqs.q: Are FCS online-learning days regular in-person school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. On October 16, 2026, and March 12, 2027, students follow the district's online learning and parent conference schedule rather than a normal in-person school day.

calendarFaqs.q: Do early-release times vary by school level?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Elementary I schools dismiss at 11:50 a.m., Elementary II schools at 12:30 p.m., middle schools at 1:30 p.m., high schools at 12:55 p.m., and Alliance Academy at 12:20 p.m.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Forsyth County Schools calendar page and the current district PDF before making travel, child care, transportation, or school-specific plans.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import and will not automatically reflect later changes made by Forsyth County Schools.

customSections.content: Several dates change the normal school-day schedule and may affect child care, transportation, or after-school plans.

groups.label: Schedule changes to plan for
items: Friday, September 4, is a K–12 early-release day before the Labor Day weekend. Schools are closed Monday, September 7.
Students learn online Friday, October 16, and do not attend school Monday, October 19, because of professional development.
Students learn online Friday, March 12, and do not attend school Monday, March 15, because of professional development.

groups.label: Break return dates
items: Students return from Holiday Break on Tuesday, January 5, after the January 4 professional development day.
After the February 12–15 student and staff holiday and the February 16 professional development day, students return Wednesday, February 17.

groups.label: Early-release times
items: Early-release times vary by school group. Elementary I schools dismiss at 11:50 a.m., Elementary II schools at 12:30 p.m., middle schools at 1:30 p.m., high schools at 12:55 p.m., and Alliance Academy at 12:20 p.m.

customSections.label: Changes from the 2025–26 Calendar
customSections.content: Compared with 2025–26, four calendar changes stand out for Forsyth families.

rows: School starts August 6 instead of August 5
The first week of school has only two instructional days: Thursday and Friday.
School ends May 27 instead of May 22
The last student day falls five days later in May and is on a Thursday.
The break starts a week later and crosses into October.
A Monday professional development day follows the March online-learning day
Students learn online Friday, March 12, and do not attend school Monday, March 15.
